security_spec.violation_condition: In the Linux KVM hypervisor (HS-mode), when vSPMP entries are modified via vsiselect/vsireg/vsireg2 indirect CSR writes and the vCPU is resumed without first executing HFENCE.VVMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0, the guest (VS/VU-mode) may observe stale vSPMP configuration, causing memory accesses to be checked against outdated protection policies.
security_spec.summary: vSPMP CSR writes via indirect CSR access are not ordered w.r.t. subsequent guest memory accesses; kernel must issue HFENCE.VVMA(rs1=x0,rs2=x0) before VM-entry after any vSPMP modification, or the guest may bypass memory protections via stale vSPMP state
